rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Exploratory, added after the main results were seen. All 40 tasks, 4 runs per name, task and request. White and Black: 20 core names each;
Hispanic and Asian: 12 extended names each (main runs); MENA: 10 names, South Asian: 8 names (add-on runs, Claude Haiku 5.5 only; the GPT-6 Luna
runs for these groups did not finish). Price panel: name-level gap vs White, 95% CI. Other panels: pooled shares with 95% Wilson intervals;
identity-linked = coily 4C hair or deep shade product, on hair and skin tasks. Open diamond: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (core names only, estimate
only). Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
